svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: My stack: the path of a request, and what ships it. Frontend (what people use): Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Pinia. Backend (where the rules live): Laravel, Livewire, PHP, Node.js, Strapi. Database (what must not get lost): PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase. Deploy (how it reaches production): AWS S3 + CloudFront, GitHub Actions, Docker (learning).
